title: Supreme Art — Pharmaceutical Packaging & Printing
description: Supreme Art manufactures pharmaceutical folding cartons — printed, die-cut, folded and glued in-house in Peshawar, Pakistan.

press.title: Pharmaceutical packaging
press.text: Unit cartons, labels and leaflets for pharmaceutical brands in Pakistan and abroad, printed on German-built Heidelberg presses and finished on Swiss Bobst lines.

capacity.title: High production
capacity.text: Built to handle large-scale orders efficiently, with precision and consistency.

about.heading: A pharmaceutical carton maker, from prepress to pallet.
about.text: Supreme Art is a Peshawar-based manufacturer of pharmaceutical folding cartons — the printed paper boxes that carry tablets, syrups, blisters and vials. We run the entire process in-house, so your artwork becomes a finished, machine-ready carton without ever leaving our floor.
points: Offset printing, die-cutting, folding & gluing in-house
Pharma-grade board with full batch traceability
Short runs through to full production volumes

media.alt: Heidelberg SM-74 press line at Supreme Art

pages.heading: Cartons for every kind of product.
pages.lead: From blister-pack tablets to syrups, supplements and spices, every carton is printed and finished under one roof in Peshawar.

items.title: Tablets & capsules
items.text: Unit cartons for blister packs, from ten-tablet strips to thirty-tablet packs, with drip-off, foil and security finishes.
items.alt: Tablet and capsule cartons: Bexus, Novex, Zolt, Duet, Carveda, Vazkor and Imo

items.title: Syrups & suspensions
items.text: Bottle cartons for 60 to 120 ml syrups and suspensions, sized to the bottle with room for the leaflet.
items.alt: Syrup cartons: Bronochol, Citolin, Fenbro 8, Fedralka, Pedrol and Novex Paracetamol

items.title: Nutraceuticals
items.text: Cartons for softgels, creams, supplements and ampoules, and hanging packs with a euro slot for the pharmacy shelf.
items.alt: Nutraceutical cartons: Vosun-D, Herbion Seaweed cream, Quench, Algae-Vit, Nova-Plast and Calciferol

items.title: Food
items.text: Full-colour spice and dessert-mix cartons, finished with food-grade coatings.
items.alt: SwaaD food cartons: Chapli Kabab, Kali Mirch, Shahi Kheer and Bombay Biryani

finishes.heading: Finishes that protect and stand out.
finishes.lead: Security features, special coatings and foils, applied in-house after printing.

process.heading: From artwork to flat-packed carton.
process.lead: Three chapters under one roof in Peshawar — this is how a carton is made at Supreme Art.

quality.heading: Built for pharma standards.
quality.text: Medicine packaging doesn’t get second chances. We run documented quality assurance across every stage: incoming board, Pantone-matched colour verified with a spectrophotometer on press, coating checks, automated 3D camera inspection of every unit carton, and a digital job card that follows each order from board to delivery.

clients.heading: Our clients.
clients.lead: Pharmaceutical and consumer brands that rely on Supreme Art for their packaging.
